question: Please find out how widespread the appeal of our top five actors is. What percentage of our customers have rented films featuring these actors?
sql:
-- Verify: total customers, customers with top 5 actor films, and the percentage
WITH top_5_actors AS (
    SELECT a.actor_id
    FROM actor a
    JOIN film_actor fa ON a.actor_id = fa.actor_id
    JOIN inventory i ON fa.film_id = i.film_id
    JOIN rental r ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
    GROUP BY a.actor_id
    ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT r.rental_id) DESC
    LIMIT 5
),
customers_with_top_5 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT r.customer_id
    FROM rental r
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id
    WHERE fa.actor_id IN (SELECT actor_id FROM top_5_actors)
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer) as total_customers,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers_with_top_5) as customers_with_top_5_films,
    ROUND((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers_with_top_5) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customer), 2) as percentage
